header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.arabic_text: اللهَ وَأُكَبِّرُهُ وَأَحْمَدُهُ وَأُسَبِّحُهُ وَأُهَلِّلُهُ حَتَّي تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُعْتِقَ رَقَبَتَيْنِ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ وُلْدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَمِنْ بَعْدِ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّي تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُعْتِقَ أَرْبَعَ رِقَابٍ مِنْ وُلْدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “For me to remain engaged after Fajr Salah until sunrise in the Dhikr of Allah Ta'ala, in proclaiming His greatness, His praise and His purity, and in saying ‘La ilaha illallah’, is dearer to me than freeing two or more than two slaves from the descendants of Hazrat Isma'il (AS). Likewise, to remain engaged in these same deeds after Asr Salah until sunset is dearer to me than freeing four slaves from the descendants of Hazrat Isma'il (AS),” the Prophet ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ بَاتَ طَاهِرًا بَاتَ فِي شِعَارِهِ مَلَكٌ فَلَمْ يَسْتَيْقِظْ إِلَّا قَالَ الْمَلَكُ: اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِعَبْدِكَ فُلَانٍ فَإِنَّهُ بَاتَ طَاهِرًا.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever sleeps at night with Wudu, an angel spends the night attached to his body. As soon as he wakes from sleep, the angel makes Du'a for him: ‘O Allah, forgive this servant of Yours! For he slept with Wudu’,” Rasulullah ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَبِيتُ عَلَي ذِكْرٍ طَاهِرًا فَيَتَعَارُّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَيَسْأَلُ اللهَ خَيْرًا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا
